svg.title: rEach and Teach: the work lifecycle
svg.desc: Seven stages from sync to receipt: sync, build, check, qualify, consent, submit and receipt. Four of them exchange sealed or signed material with Teach.
svg.text: One slice of one assignment, from the first sealed package to the signed receipt.
course server · private to the instructors
timestamps it, enforces the due time
Three failed tries raise a hand
rEach tells the instructors on its own, and at the hard stop the agent may write no more.
Offline is not a dead end
The gate passes for up to 24 hours on verified rules, and submissions wait in a queue.
